question: Who do Arsenal play next, and when?
ground_truth_sql: with t as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Arsenal' or display_name ilike 'Arsenal') select f.fixture_id, l.name competition, f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time, h.display_name home_team, a.display_name away_team, f.status from fixtures f join leagues l using(league_id) join teams h on h.team_id=f.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=f.away_team_id where f.status='scheduled' and f.kickoff_date>=current_date and (f.home_team_id in (select team_id from t) or f.away_team_id in (select team_id from t)) order by f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time limit 1
must_include: names the opponent from ground truth
gives the kickoff date (and time, UK) from ground truth
states the competition and whether Arsenal are home or away
must_not_claim: a fixture dated in the past
a different competition's fixture as 'next' when an earlier one exists
a confirmed TV slot unless sourced
notes: Next fixture across all tracked competitions (PL, UCL, Carabao Cup). kickoff_time is UK local time as stored. Live on 2026-09-26: Arsenal v Leeds, PL, 2026-10-10 12:30 (international break explains the gap).

question: What was the score the last time Liverpool played Everton?
ground_truth_sql: with liv as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Liverpool' or display_name ilike 'Liverpool'), eve as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Everton' or display_name ilike 'Everton') select m.match_date, l.name competition, s.slug season, h.display_name home_team, m.full_time_home_goals, m.full_time_away_goals, a.display_name away_team, m.full_time_result from matches m join leagues l using(league_id) join seasons s using(season_id) join teams h on h.team_id=m.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=m.away_team_id where ((m.home_team_id in (select team_id from liv) and m.away_team_id in (select team_id from eve)) or (m.home_team_id in (select team_id from eve) and m.away_team_id in (select team_id from liv))) and m.full_time_home_goals is not null and m.match_date<=current_date order by m.match_date desc limit 1
must_include: gives the scoreline with the correct home/away orientation
gives the match date and competition from ground truth
must_not_claim: a fixture that has not been played yet
a different Merseyside derby's score
notes: Live on 2026-09-26: Everton 1-2 Liverpool, PL, 2026-04-19.

question: How many Premier League goals have been scored so far this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select count(*) matches_played, sum(full_time_home_goals+full_time_away_goals) total_goals, round(avg(full_time_home_goals+full_time_away_goals),2) goals_per_game, max(match_date) latest_match_included from matches where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur) and full_time_home_goals is not null
must_include: total goals equals ground truth
states number of matches it covers (or date of latest included match)
must_not_claim: goals from other competitions (cups, UCL) counted in the total
notes: Results load 1-3 days after matches; answer should be 'as of the latest loaded result'. Live: 141 goals in 50 matches (2.82/game).

question: Which Championship team has drawn the most matches this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select t.display_name, s.played, s.won, s.drawn, s.lost, s.points, s.position from league_standings s join teams t using(team_id) where s.league_code='E1' and s.season_id=(select season_id from cur) and s.drawn=(select max(drawn) from league_standings where league_code='E1' and season_id=(select season_id from cur)) order by s.position
must_include: names every team tied on the maximum number of draws
states the number of draws
must_not_claim: a Premier League or other division's team
notes: Live: Birmingham, 5 draws from 8.

question: Which Bundesliga teams are still unbeaten this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select t.display_name, s.position, s.played, s.won, s.drawn, s.lost, s.points from league_standings s join teams t using(team_id) where s.league_code='D1' and s.season_id=(select season_id from cur) and s.lost=0 order by s.position
must_include: lists exactly the teams in ground truth
league matches only
must_not_claim: cup or European results affect 'unbeaten'
a team not in ground truth
notes: Bundesliga = D1 (league_id 14). Live: Dortmund, Bayern, Freiburg after 4 rounds.

question: Who's top of the Premier League, with any point deductions applied?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select s.position, t.display_name, s.played, s.won, s.drawn, s.lost, s.goals_for, s.goals_against, s.points_won, s.deduction, s.points, (select count(*) from point_deductions pd where pd.league_id=s.league_id and pd.season_id=s.season_id) pl_deductions_this_season from league_standings s join teams t using(team_id) where s.league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and s.season_id=(select season_id from cur) order by s.position limit 3
must_include: names the leader and points from ground truth
states whether any PL deductions apply this season (live: none)
must_not_claim: an invented deduction
a Championship deduction (e.g. Southampton -4) applied to the PL table
notes: league_standings already nets point_deductions. Live: Man City 15 pts; no PL deductions in 2026/27.

question: Which Premier League team has the best record over its last 10 home league matches?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)), pl as (select home_team_id team_id from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur) union select away_team_id from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur)), home as (select m.home_team_id team_id, m.match_date, m.full_time_home_goals gf, m.full_time_away_goals ga, l.code, row_number() over (partition by m.home_team_id order by m.match_date desc) rn from matches m join leagues l using(league_id) where l.competition_type='league' and m.home_team_id in (select team_id from pl) and m.full_time_home_goals is not null) select t.display_name, count(*) n, sum((gf>ga)::int) w, sum((gf=ga)::int) d, sum((gf<ga)::int) l, sum(case when gf>ga then 3 when gf=ga then 1 else 0 end) pts, sum(gf) gf, sum(ga) ga, min(match_date) window_from, string_agg(distinct code, ',') divisions from home join teams t using(team_id) where rn<=10 group by t.display_name order by pts desc, sum(gf)-sum(ga) desc limit 5
must_include: names the top team and its W-D-L / points over the 10 home games
notes the 10-game window spans last season too (and, for promoted clubs, Championship games)
must_not_claim: that the window is only this season's games
notes: 'League matches' = competition_type 'league', window crosses seasons. Live: Man City 8W1D1L (25 pts); Arsenal and Man United 24.

question: Which Premier League team has improved most, comparing points from its last 10 league matches with the 10 before?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)), pl as (select home_team_id team_id from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur) union select away_team_id from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur)), g as (select m.home_team_id team_id, m.match_date, m.full_time_home_goals gf, m.full_time_away_goals ga from matches m join leagues l using(league_id) where l.competition_type='league' and m.full_time_home_goals is not null union all select m.away_team_id, m.match_date, m.full_time_away_goals, m.full_time_home_goals from matches m join leagues l using(league_id) where l.competition_type='league' and m.full_time_home_goals is not null), r as (select g.*, row_number() over (partition by team_id order by match_date desc) rn, case when gf>ga then 3 when gf=ga then 1 else 0 end pts from g where team_id in (select team_id from pl)), a as (select team_id, sum(pts) filter (where rn<=10) last10, sum(pts) filter (where rn between 11 and 20) prev10 from r where rn<=20 group by team_id) select t.display_name, last10, prev10, last10-prev10 improvement from a join teams t using(team_id) order by improvement desc, last10 desc limit 5
must_include: names the team with the largest points increase and both 10-game totals
notes the windows cross seasons
must_not_claim: a points change not computed from consecutive league matches
notes: Question clarified to 'last 10 league matches' (was 'last 10 matches') so cup games are excluded. Live: Tottenham 12 vs 3 (+9).

question: Which Premier League team has conceded the fewest goals this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select t.display_name, s.played, s.goals_against, s.clean_sheets, s.position from league_standings s join teams t using(team_id) where s.league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and s.season_id=(select season_id from cur) and s.goals_against=(select min(goals_against) from league_standings where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur)) order by s.position
must_include: names all teams tied on the minimum goals against
states the number conceded
must_not_claim: a single outright leader when there is a tie
notes: Live: Everton and Leeds tied on 3 conceded.

question: How do Serie A and La Liga compare on goals per game this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)) select l.name, count(*) matches, sum(full_time_home_goals+full_time_away_goals) goals, round(avg(full_time_home_goals+full_time_away_goals)::numeric,2) goals_per_game, round(avg(full_time_home_goals)::numeric,2) home_gpg, round(avg(full_time_away_goals)::numeric,2) away_gpg from matches m join leagues l using(league_id) where l.code in ('I1','SP1') and m.season_id=(select season_id from cur) and full_time_home_goals is not null group by l.name
must_include: gives goals per game for both leagues matching ground truth (2 dp)
says which is higher
mentions sample size (matches played)
must_not_claim: historic-season figures presented as this season
notes: Live: La Liga 3.04 (69 games) vs Serie A 2.90 (50 games).

question: What's FixtureShark's prediction for Chelsea's next Premier League match?
ground_truth_sql: with t as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Chelsea' or display_name ilike 'Chelsea'), nf as (select f.* from fixtures f where f.league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and f.status='scheduled' and f.kickoff_date>=current_date and (f.home_team_id in (select team_id from t) or f.away_team_id in (select team_id from t)) order by f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time limit 1) select nf.kickoff_date, nf.kickoff_time, h.display_name home, a.display_name away, round(nf.predicted_home_goals::numeric,2) xg_home, round(nf.predicted_away_goals::numeric,2) xg_away, r.fit_run_id, r.fitted_at, round(r.rho::numeric,3) rho, m.home_win, m.draw, m.away_win, m.over_2_5, m.btts from nf join teams h on h.team_id=nf.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=nf.away_team_id join model_fit_runs r on r.fit_run_id=nf.prediction_fit_run_id cross join lateral fixture_derived_markets(nf.predicted_home_goals::numeric, nf.predicted_away_goals::numeric, r.rho::numeric) m
must_include: names opponent and date
gives model expected goals for both sides (±0.05)
gives H/D/A probabilities within 1pp of ground truth
frames them as Dixon-Coles model estimates
must_not_claim: certainty about the result
bookmaker odds
a confirmed lineup
notes: Reworded from 'Chelsea's next match' to 'next Premier League match': cup/UCL fixtures carry no predictions. Probabilities use the rho of the fit that produced the fixture's prediction (prediction_fit_run_id), which can lag the newest fit by a day.

question: What's the most likely scoreline in Man City's next Premier League match?
ground_truth_sql: with t as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Man City' or display_name ilike 'Manchester City'), nf as (select f.* from fixtures f where f.league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and f.status='scheduled' and f.kickoff_date>=current_date and (f.home_team_id in (select team_id from t) or f.away_team_id in (select team_id from t)) order by f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time limit 1), p as (select nf.kickoff_date, nf.home_team_id, nf.away_team_id, nf.predicted_home_goals lh, nf.predicted_away_goals la, r.rho from nf join model_fit_runs r on r.fit_run_id=nf.prediction_fit_run_id), grid as (select p.*, h, a, (case when h=0 and a=0 then 1-lh*la*rho when h=0 and a=1 then 1+lh*rho when h=1 and a=0 then 1+la*rho when h=1 and a=1 then 1-rho else 1 end) * exp(-lh)*power(lh,h)/factorial(h)::float8 * exp(-la)*power(la,a)/factorial(a)::float8 as pr from p, generate_series(0,8) h, generate_series(0,8) a) select g.kickoff_date, th.display_name home, ta.display_name away, round(g.lh::numeric,2) xg_home, round(g.la::numeric,2) xg_away, g.h||'-'||g.a scoreline, round((100*g.pr/sum(g.pr) over ())::numeric,2) prob_pct from grid g join teams th on th.team_id=g.home_team_id join teams ta on ta.team_id=g.away_team_id order by g.pr desc limit 5
must_include: gives the top scoreline from ground truth (home-away order)
gives its probability (~13%) and notes it is low in absolute terms
names the opponent and date
must_not_claim: that the scoreline is likely to happen in an absolute sense
a probability above ~20% for any exact score
notes: Reworded to 'next Premier League match' (UCL fixtures have no model). Grid is the Dixon-Coles 0-8 grid with low-score correction, as in fixture_derived_markets. Live: Liverpool v Man City, 1-1 at 13.1%.

question: Which favourite in the next Premier League matchweek is most vulnerable to an upset?
ground_truth_sql: with e0 as (select league_id from leagues where code='E0'), nmw as (select season_id, matchweek from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from e0) and status='scheduled' and kickoff_date>=current_date order by kickoff_date, kickoff_time limit 1), fx as (select f.* from fixtures f join nmw using(season_id, matchweek) where f.league_id=(select league_id from e0)), m as (select fx.matchweek, fx.kickoff_date, fx.home_team_id, fx.away_team_id, d.* from fx join model_fit_runs r on r.fit_run_id=fx.prediction_fit_run_id cross join lateral fixture_derived_markets(fx.predicted_home_goals::numeric, fx.predicted_away_goals::numeric, r.rho::numeric) d) select m.matchweek, m.kickoff_date, h.display_name home, a.display_name away, m.home_win, m.draw, m.away_win, case when m.home_win>=m.away_win then h.display_name else a.display_name end favourite, greatest(m.home_win,m.away_win) favourite_win_pct, least(m.home_win,m.away_win) underdog_win_pct from m join teams h on h.team_id=m.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=m.away_team_id order by favourite_win_pct asc limit 5
must_include: identifies the favourite with the lowest model win probability in the next matchweek (first row)
quotes its win % and the underdog's win %
defines 'vulnerable' (e.g. lowest favourite win probability)
must_not_claim: a matchweek other than the next one
bookmaker-based favourites
notes: Vulnerability = favourite (higher of home/away win prob) with the lowest win probability. Live MW6: Everton at Hull (33.5% vs 31.7%, draw 34.8%). Accept a well-argued alternative metric only if it names a fixture in the top 2.

question: Rank Liverpool's next five Premier League fixtures by difficulty.
ground_truth_sql: with t as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Liverpool' or display_name ilike 'Liverpool' limit 1), nf as (select f.* from fixtures f where f.league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and f.status='scheduled' and f.kickoff_date>=current_date and (f.home_team_id=(select team_id from t) or f.away_team_id=(select team_id from t)) order by f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time limit 5), x as (select nf.*, (nf.home_team_id=(select team_id from t)) is_home, d.* from nf join model_fit_runs r on r.fit_run_id=nf.prediction_fit_run_id cross join lateral fixture_derived_markets(nf.predicted_home_goals::numeric, nf.predicted_away_goals::numeric, r.rho::numeric) d) select x.matchweek, x.kickoff_date, case when is_home then 'H' else 'A' end venue, o.display_name opponent, round((case when is_home then predicted_home_goals else predicted_away_goals end)::numeric,2) liv_xg, round((case when is_home then predicted_away_goals else predicted_home_goals end)::numeric,2) opp_xg, case when is_home then home_win else away_win end liv_win_pct, draw draw_pct, case when is_home then away_win else home_win end liv_loss_pct, rank() over (order by case when is_home then home_win else away_win end asc) difficulty_rank from x join teams o on o.team_id = case when is_home then x.away_team_id else x.home_team_id end order by difficulty_rank
must_include: lists the five fixtures from ground truth with venue
ranks by a model-based measure (Liverpool win % or loss %)
hardest group and easiest fixture consistent with ground truth
must_not_claim: fixtures beyond the next five
a ranking based only on league position without saying so
notes: Difficulty = Liverpool model win probability (lower = harder). Live top three (Man City H, Arsenal H, Brentford A) are within 1pp of each other, so any order among them is acceptable; Crystal Palace (A) is easiest.

question: How did FixtureShark's probabilities compare with the market for Arsenal's last match?
ground_truth_sql: with t as (select team_id from teams where canonical_name ilike 'Arsenal' or display_name ilike 'Arsenal' limit 1), lm as (select m.* from matches m where (m.home_team_id=(select team_id from t) or m.away_team_id=(select team_id from t)) and m.full_time_home_goals is not null and m.match_date<=current_date order by m.match_date desc limit 1), o as (select o.* from match_odds o join lm using(match_id) where o.market='1x2' and o.bookmaker='Avg' order by o.is_closing desc limit 1), last_row as (select 'last_match' row_kind, lm.match_date, l.name competition, h.display_name home, a.display_name away, lm.full_time_home_goals||'-'||lm.full_time_away_goals score, d.home_win model_home, d.draw model_draw, d.away_win model_away, (select round(100*(1/price_home)/((1/price_home)+(1/price_draw)+(1/price_away)),2) from o) market_home, (select round(100*(1/price_draw)/((1/price_home)+(1/price_draw)+(1/price_away)),2) from o) market_draw, (select round(100*(1/price_away)/((1/price_home)+(1/price_draw)+(1/price_away)),2) from o) market_away from lm join leagues l using(league_id) join teams h on h.team_id=lm.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=lm.away_team_id left join match_predictions mp on mp.match_id=lm.match_id left join model_fit_runs r on r.fit_run_id=mp.fit_run_id left join lateral fixture_derived_markets(mp.predicted_home_goals::numeric, mp.predicted_away_goals::numeric, r.rho::numeric) d on true), sc as (select s.* from model_scorecard_matches s join matches m using(match_id) where (m.home_team_id=(select team_id from t) or m.away_team_id=(select team_id from t)) and s.m_home is not null order by s.match_date desc limit 1), sc_row as (select 'latest_with_market', sc.match_date, l.name, h.display_name, a.display_name, sc.hg||'-'||sc.ag, round(100*sc.p_home,2), round(100*sc.p_draw,2), round(100*sc.p_away,2), round(100*sc.m_home,2), round(100*sc.m_draw,2), round(100*sc.m_away,2) from sc join matches m using(match_id) join leagues l on l.league_id=m.league_id join teams h on h.team_id=m.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=m.away_team_id) select * from last_row union all select * from sc_row
must_include: identifies Arsenal's last match and result
gives the model's H/D/A for it
says market odds are not available for that match if market columns are NULL
optionally offers the latest Arsenal match that has both (row 'latest_with_market')
must_not_claim: market probabilities for a match where ground truth has none
that the model 'beat the market' on a single game
answerability_note: Partially: match_odds for 2026/27 PL stop at 2026-09-06 (MW3), so Arsenal's last match (Brighton 3-0 Arsenal, 2026-09-19) has model probabilities but no market odds. Latest comparable Arsenal match: Arsenal 2-1 Chelsea (2026-09-06), model 66/22/12 vs market 56/25/20.
notes: Market = de-margined closing 'Avg' 1X2. For current-season matches the model_scorecard_matches row uses the fixture prediction; match_predictions holds the point-in-time prediction for the last match.

question: Why does FixtureShark rate Arsenal above Chelsea? Compare their current attack and defence ratings.
ground_truth_sql: select canonical_name, fit_run_id, fitted_at, round(attack_strength::numeric,3) attack_strength, round(defence_strength::numeric,3) defence_strength, attack_score, defence_score, attack_rank, defence_rank, overall_score, is_estimated from team_strength_current where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and team_id in (select team_id from teams where canonical_name in ('Arsenal','Chelsea') or display_name in ('Arsenal','Chelsea')) order by overall_score desc
must_include: quotes both teams' attack and defence ratings or ranks from ground truth
explains the gap is mainly defence (Arsenal best defence vs Chelsea mid/low)
explains higher defence = fewer goals conceded in this model
must_not_claim: ratings from a rejected or old fit
that the ratings include manual overrides unless shown

question: How much is home advantage worth in the Premier League model, and has it changed over recent fits?
ground_truth_sql: select fit_run_id, fitted_at::date fit_date, model_version, round(home_advantage::numeric,4) home_advantage, round(exp(home_advantage)::numeric,3) home_goal_multiplier, matches_used, window_start_date, window_end_date from model_fit_runs where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and status='accepted' and not coalesce(is_retrofit,false) order by fitted_at desc limit 10
must_include: gives current home advantage (log scale ~0.18) and its multiplier (~1.20x home expected goals)
describes the recent trend (step from ~0.173 to ~0.185 around 22 Sep, stable since)
must_not_claim: a home advantage in points or win percentage presented as the model parameter
values from rejected fits
notes: Home advantage enters as exp(h) on the home side's expected goals. The ~22 Sep step coincides with MW5 results (loaded 22 Sep) and the dc_v1_1 change.

question: How accurate have FixtureShark's Premier League predictions been this season?
ground_truth_sql: with cur as (select season_id from seasons where current_date >= make_date(start_year,7,1) and current_date < make_date(end_year,7,1)), s as (select * from get_model_accuracy_summary((select league_id from leagues where code='E0'))), mk as (select count(*) n_with_market, round(100.0*avg(((p_home>=p_draw and p_home>=p_away and result='H') or (p_draw>p_home and p_draw>=p_away and result='D') or (p_away>p_home and p_away>p_draw and result='A'))::int),1) sample_model_hit_pct, round(100.0*avg(((m_home>=m_draw and m_home>=m_away and result='H') or (m_draw>m_home and m_draw>=m_away and result='D') or (m_away>m_home and m_away>m_draw and result='A'))::int),1) market_hit_pct, round(avg(power(p_home-(result='H')::int,2)+power(p_draw-(result='D')::int,2)+power(p_away-(result='A')::int,2)),4) sample_model_brier, round(avg(power(m_home-(result='H')::int,2)+power(m_draw-(result='D')::int,2)+power(m_away-(result='A')::int,2)),4) market_brier, max(match_date) market_sample_to from model_scorecard_matches where league_id=(select league_id from leagues where code='E0') and season_id=(select season_id from cur) and m_home is not null) select s.*, mk.* from s cross join mk
must_include: gives fixtures scored, hit rate and Brier vs the 0.6667 uniform baseline from ground truth
compares with the always-home baseline
notes the small sample; if comparing with the market, notes that sample is shorter (odds only to MW3) and the market Brier is better
must_not_claim: that the model beats the bookmakers
multi-season accuracy figures presented as this season

question: Which Premier League games in the next matchweek aren't on UK TV?
ground_truth_sql: with e0 as (select league_id from leagues where code='E0'), nmw as (select season_id, matchweek from fixtures where league_id=(select league_id from e0) and status='scheduled' and kickoff_date>=current_date order by kickoff_date, kickoff_time limit 1) select f.matchweek, f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time, h.display_name home, a.display_name away, case when bool_or(b.status='confirmed_not_televised') then 'confirmed_not_televised' when bool_or(b.status='confirmed_broadcast' and coalesce(b.uk_available,true)) then 'televised' else 'unknown_no_broadcast_info' end uk_tv_status, string_agg(distinct b.broadcaster, ', ') broadcasters from fixtures f join nmw using(season_id, matchweek) join teams h on h.team_id=f.home_team_id join teams a on a.team_id=f.away_team_id left join fixture_broadcasts b on b.fixture_id=f.fixture_id and b.market='GB' where f.league_id=(select league_id from e0) group by f.fixture_id, f.matchweek, f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time, h.display_name, a.display_name order by uk_tv_status desc, f.kickoff_date, f.kickoff_time

a broadcaster for the unknown fixtures

question: Tell me Arsenal's confirmed starting XI for Saturday.
